headline: Fullstack Engineer II - Conversational Analytic
description_text:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
You’ll join the Platform team, focused on building AI-native conversational analytics experiences that help teams across Spotify explore, understand, and act on data more intuitively. We’re rethinking how people interact with analytics by combining modern fullstack engineering with LLM-powered interfaces. This is a highly collaborative environment where engineers, product, and data partners work closely to shape the future of internal data experiences.

headline: Senior Product Manager, Core Experience (Playback)
description_text:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the playback experience across Spotify’s mobile apps. This is one of the most highly used parts of the product, where millions of users engage with music, podcasts, audiobooks, and video every day. You’ll shape how content, controls, and context come together to create seamless, personalized listening experiences in real time.

headline: Engineering Manager - AI Fleet Management & Honk
description_text:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

What if the systems you built changed how millions of developers work — not just at Spotify, but across the industry? The Platform Developer Experience (PDX) team builds the infrastructure and internal products that power how Spotify engineers ship software. Within PDX, the Wingspan team is building the next generation of fleet management and reimagining how we interact with AI agents — and bringing those capabilities to market through Portal, Spotify’s external developer platform built on Backstage.
 
We are redesigning platform engineering around intelligent agents, large language models, and decision-aware automation. In this role, you’ll lead a team shaping how AI becomes a core operating layer of modern platform infrastructure, directly improving how developers ship and maintain software at scale.

headline: Product Manager - Platform Tooling
description_text:
Mission Statement
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
About the Team
You’ll join a team building shared web tooling, frameworks, and operator-facing products that power Spotify’s internal financial workflows. Our mission is simple (but not easy): make complex work easier, smoother, and more intuitive for our operators, while keeping our infrastructure scalable and easy to build on.
We focus on creating a consistent, thoughtful experience across internal tools and connected SaaS systems, helping finance operators move seamlessly between products every day. Alongside mature platforms, we’re also building new workflow and task management experiences, with a growing investment in AI-powered capabilities to support smarter decision-making.

headline: Senior Editor, Music Editorial - Nordics
description_text:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Editor for Norway & Finland, to join Spotify’s Music Editorial team based in Stockholm. In this role you will be a part of the Music team in the Nordics, reporting into the regional Head of Editorial. 

You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, including playlist curation, creative editorial work, and cross-functional collaboration with different teams in the region and beyond. You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners in Norway and Finland, shaping how listeners in these markets experience music on Spotify across playlists, programming, and emerging editorial formats. Additionally, you will drive artist discovery through an extensive editorial ecosystem of playlists and tools, critically assessing music trends and user behaviour to identify opportunities and emerging trends.
You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through emerging, creative Editorial formats, bringing music to life in innovative ways.
As a music editor, you will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music!

headline: Data Analyst II – Performance Optimization Squad
description_text:
The Performance Optimization Squad is a newly formed team in the Core Infrastructure Studio with a mission to establish a core competency in performance engineering and address systemic inefficiencies across Spotify's platform. With 3,200+ microservices, 40,000 VMs at peak, and 500,000 K8s pods, even minor fleet-wide efficiency improvements result in substantial cost savings. We've already identified $8M+ in annual savings from our first initiative alone, and we're just getting started.
This squad works horizontally across the entire stack — but none of that optimization happens without the data to see it. We're looking for a Data Analyst who will build the measurement foundation that drives every decision we make.

headline: Engineering Manager - Core Infrastructure
description_text:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
You’ll join the Core Infrastructure studio within Spotify’s Platform mission, specifically the Manifesto squad. This team builds and evolves the foundational infrastructure that powers Spotify at scale—helping hundreds of engineers ship faster, more reliably, and with confidence. You’ll lead a team working on critical systems that enable resilience, performance, and developer productivity across the company.

headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Generative UI Platform
description_text:
UI Studio is Spotify’s internal generative UI prototyping platform that enables teams to spin up fully functioning replicas of Spotify surfaces — complete with playable music — to explore and pitch new product ideas. What started as a small internal project has evolved into a widely adopted platform, and we’re now expanding it into a full generative UI system where teams can prompt for the interfaces they need.
You’ll join a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of machine learning, design systems, and product development — helping shape how user interfaces are imagined and built at Spotify.

headline: Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
description_text:
We're hiring a Senior Security Engineer to lead and raise the bar for enterprise security at Spotify. In this role, you'll be hands-on across core security domains, IAM, endpoint management, networking, and shaping how we secure an increasingly AI-enabled enterprise. You'll build tooling and automation, define policies and guardrails, and partner closely with teams across IT, infrastructure, legal, and beyond to keep Spotify moving fast without compromising on security.
The ideal candidate brings solid professional experience in enterprise security, strong technical foundations, and a genuine comfort with AI, both as a tool to augment their own work and as a surface area to secure. Just as importantly, you're an excellent communicator who can translate security priorities into language that resonates across a global, cross-functional organization.

headline: Partner Delivery Lead - Music
description_text:
Live Music at Spotify is dedicated to connecting fans with live experiences — bridging the world of streaming and the concert floor. Our team works at the intersection of Spotify's massive listener base and the live events ecosystem, helping fans discover, access, and attend the shows they love.
The Partner Operations team sits at the heart of the Live Music business, leading customer success for our live event affiliate program and owning the operational infrastructure that keeps our ticket partner ecosystem running and growing. We operationalize new business offerings — which means we take things that don't yet have a playbook and build one. We're metrics-driven and KPI-focused, and we actively invest in AI tooling and modern ops practices to stay efficient as the program scales.
We're at an inflection point. We're currently standing up operations for a major new offering, with a significant scaling push expected in H2. It's a rare opportunity to join a team mid-build — where your fingerprints will be on the systems, processes, and outcomes that define how this program grows. If you're someone who gets excited by turning ambiguity into structure, and you want to work somewhere that takes both live music and operational excellence seriously — this is the team.

headline: Fullstack Engineer - Generative UI Platform
description_text:
UI Studio is Spotify’s internal generative UI prototyping platform that enables teams to spin up fully functioning replicas of Spotify surfaces — complete with playable music — to explore and pitch new product ideas. What started as a small internal project has evolved into a widely adopted platform, and we’re now expanding it into a full generative UI system where teams can prompt for the interfaces they need.
We’re looking for a Fullstack Engineer who is strong across backend systems and confident building high-quality frontend experiences — to help scale the platform’s technical foundations and AI-native capabilities. You’ll play a meaningful role in shaping architecture, evolving core systems, and delivering reliable, developer-facing platform functionality used across Spotify.

headline: Group Product Manager, Experience (Core Experience)
description_text:
Delivering the best Spotify experience possible — to as many people as possible, in as many moments as possible. That’s what the Experience team is all about. We use our deep understanding of consumer expectations to enrich the lives of hundreds of millions of users around the world, bringing the music and audio they love to the devices, apps, and platforms they use every day.
We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to join Core Experience, leading a group of product managers responsible for key parts of Spotify’s end-to-end mobile experience on iOS and Android. This includes features that millions of users interact with every day, for example Your Library, as well as the shared UI and interaction patterns that underpin Spotify’s mobile product.

headline: Senior Project Manager - WorkplaceX Design & Build
description_text:
The Workplace Experience team (WorkplaceX) enables Spotifiers to do their best work by delivering an inspiring and frictionless workplace.
 
We are looking for an outstanding Senior Project Manager to join our Design & Build team. In this exciting role, you will be responsible for the full project lifecycle and will run projects that transform our offices globally.

headline: Data Scientist II - Platform Mission
description_text:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
 
The SAFE Insights team supports the five studios that make up the SAFE Alliance: User Platform, User Fraud, IT, Security, and PACE (Procurement, Analytics, and Cost Engineering). We help these studios understand their impact by running experiments, defining and building performance metrics, and delivering analyses that guide decision-making. As a Data Scientist on the team, you’ll collaborate across disciplines to surface insights, shape product thinking, and strengthen a culture of evidence-driven decisions.

headline: Android Engineer - Platform Engineering
description_text:
Client Platform is an R&D studio that empowers hundreds of client developers to work efficiently on performance and stability in the Spotify apps, ultimately enabling them to deliver an awesome experience to Spotify users.
 
We make this happen by providing observability and tools that collect performance and stability measurements and data, serving it to the feature squads in a clear and actionable way. We collaborate closely with our internal customers to understand needs and build a platform that fits. At times, we team up directly with feature squads to integrate our tooling and use it to identify and implement improvements directly in the app.
 
Right now we are working on our next generation observability platform, which will gather different observations from the clients into one view, enabling engineers to understand what is happening at any given time, to find bottlenecks and better act on bugs and regressions.

headline: Engineering Manager - Experimentation
description_text:
Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products.
 
At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product.
 
The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery.
